blindFormulaPacket.surfactantArchitecture: Primary anionic: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2). Buffers: Cocamidopropyl Betaine (5, amphoteric), Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate (6, mild amino-acid anionic), Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate (7, amphoteric). Minor mild ether-sulfate blend after Panthenol: Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate (9), Magnesium Laureth Sulfate (11), Magnesium Laureth-8-Sulfate (12), Sodium Oleth Sulfate (14), Magnesium Oleth Sulfate (15), plus nonionic Laureth-4 (13). No chelator, no clarifying route.
blindFormulaPacket.conditioningRoutes: No cationic polymer, no silicone, no oil/lipid payload. Light routes only: Glycol Distearate (10, pearlizer), Panthenol (8).
blindFormulaPacket.humectantRefatting: Urea (3; 3% per pack), Panthenol (8), Glycerin (20, trace position).
blindFormulaPacket.scalpActives: No Piroctone Olamine, no Climbazole. Comfort: Urea (3), Panthenol (8). Acidic pH system: Citric Acid (17), Formic Acid (21).
blindFormulaPacket.unresolved: Proportion of the ether-sulfate blend at 9-15 is unknown (INCI order only).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: an early SLES base buffered by two amphoterics and a mild amino-acid surfactant, with no reset/clarifying route or intent — the C1 pattern.

formulaFacts.ingredient: Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate / Magnesium Laureth Sulfate / Magnesium Laureth-8-Sulfate / Sodium Oleth Sulfate / Magnesium Oleth Sulfate

cleansingStrength.counterSignals: Five further ether-sulfate tokens (9-15) could be read as a second anionic route; SLES clearly leads the formula, so 'low' is not supported.
cleansingStrength.notes: The 9-15 cluster is the classic mild Mg/laureth-8/oleth ether-sulfate blend used in mild shampoos. It sits after Panthenol and is read as part of the same buffered ether-sulfate route, not as a reinforcing reset route. Precedent: Eucerin DermoCapillaire pH5 (SLES/SMES + amphoacetate, pH/sensitive positioning) adjudicated moderate in holdout-v3.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: no cationic polymer, silicone or lipid. Only a pearlizer and humectants, which give little rinse-off slip.
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: The 'several light routes' wording in the moderate anchor (pearlizer + panthenol + urea) is the only path upward. Pack says 'ohne Silikone'.
ruleIds: C2 (not met: no silicone, no cationic)

weightPotential.rationale: Low: no hair-substantive deposition system at all, and an effective cleansing base.

formulaFacts.role: only film/fatty clue; pearlizer, low persistence

weightPotential.counterSignals: Glycol Distearate can leave a slight film. It is one weak, low-persistence route.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is light and low-persistence; nothing makes loss of movement/root lift likely.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Moderate needs one meaningfully persistent system (cationic, silicone, rich lipid). None is present.

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: the brand owner positions it explicitly for sensitive scalp ('Spezialentwicklung für sensible Kopfhaut', pH 5,5 hautneutral, 3% Urea), and the formula is compatible (buffered cleansing, urea + panthenol, acidic pH).

careDirection.limitation: The 'Feuchtigkeits-Komplex / schützt Kopfhaut & Haar vor Austrocknung' claim has humectants but no conditioning/emollient/deposition support, so it does not reach moisture_supported for the lengths.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: SLES is the lead surfactant and Parfum (16) is present. The sensitive-scalp claim is on rossmann.de, not on the pack front (front says only pH 5,5 hautneutral / 3% Urea / normales Haar).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula: mild-buffered ether-sulfate wash with scalp humectants; no length-care system. Claims: sensitive scalp + pH-neutral (dominant), moisture (secondary). The moisture verdict is nonspecific, so it stays out. Sensitive-scalp positioning plus scalpComfortTarget targeted -> scalp_active (Section 7.2 row 'Explicit sensitive ... scalp positioning with targeted'). If the sensitive claim were discounted, the product would fall to general (mildness alone is not a focus).

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the only other claim, moisture, has a nonspecific formula verdict (humectants without conditioning/deposition), so it fails Section 8 condition 2.
focusSecondary.counterSignals: 'Feuchtigkeits-Komplex' and 'schützt ... Haar vor Austrocknung' are distinct claims.

usageRole.rationale: frequent: explicit 'für jeden Tag' positioning and cleansing is not strong (mechanical trigger).
usageRole.counterSignals: Depends on cleansingStrength staying moderate. If it were strong, the result would mechanically be regular.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: targeted: explicit sensitive-scalp positioning plus a credible supportive architecture (buffered cleansing, 3% urea, panthenol, pH 5.5 system).
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignals: Parfum (16) is declared (not fragrance-free). The SLES lead is milder than a reset chassis but not a gentle amino-acid/amphoteric base. No allantoin/bisabolol.
scalpComfortTarget.notes: Fragrance is a counter-signal, not a veto (Section 10). Precedent: Eucerin DermoCapillaire pH5 (with fragrance) = targeted, moderate.

dandruffSupport.rationale: not_supported: the complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

projection.status: proposal (all eight properties moderate-or-high, identity canonical)

thicknesses.rationale: T1: W low -> fine ideal. T4: W neighbor 'none', so no boundary flag. T2: pack 'normales Haar' does not change fit.
T1: W low -> normal ideal. No T4 flag.
T1: W low and C not high -> coarse conditional (usable with a separate conditioner). Not emitted (T5). Min(W high, C moderate) = moderate.

primary.rationale: S-SENSITIVE. Positioning gate (E1/E2): 'Spezialentwicklung für sensible Kopfhaut' names a sensitive scalp. It appears on rossmann.de (the brand owner's exact product page), not the pack front -> positioning confidence moderate. Formula gate: scalpComfortTarget targeted AND prominent comfort routes (E3: before Parfum at 16): Panthenol (8), Urea (3). cleansingStrength moderate -> no review_strong_cleansing_comfort_route. S-FOCUS: focusPrimary scalp_active -> no mismatch.

scalpTargets.secondaryRationale: S-DRY not emitted. 'schützt Kopfhaut & Haar vor Austrocknung' names the scalp but is a preventive claim, not a dry-scalp condition claim like the E2 examples ('trockene Kopfhaut', 'Spannungsgefühl'). Under P0 the uncertain lexicon match fails conservative (no secondary). The formula gate would pass (targeted + Urea 3/Panthenol 8 prominent), so this lexicon reading alone decides it. See openIssues.

observedCleansingIntensity.rationale: I1: cleansingStrength moderate -> regular. I2: written unchanged even though the irritationen bucket expects gentle, so the live matcher would rank these rows 'supportive', not 'ideal'. I3: the cleansing neighbor 'strong' would also yield regular -> no review_intensity_boundary.

positioning.rationale: D1: no Tiefenreinigung/Clarifying/Detox wording and no occasional-use limit. Directions say 'für jeden Tag'.

customerFit.customer: Viola (wavy, FINE strands, HIGH density, medium length, colored + bleached, elastic test snaps, dry scalp without current flakes/itch, main problem dry lengths; also frizz, tangling, low shine, lost wave shape; washes ~2x/week, this shampoo ~1x/week; then Syoss Intense Glaze lamination mask as conditioner, Neqi leave-in mist, Neqi Opulent Oil)
customerFit.summary: Fine to keep as her weekly wash. It is weightless (good for fine wavy strands), silicone-free, pH 5.5 with urea + panthenol (friendly to a dry-feeling scalp), and its moderate cleansing removes residue from the glaze mask and oil. It does nothing for her main problems (dry, tangly, snapping lengths). Those belong to the mask/leave-in and to wash technique. No reason to swap unless the lengths feel squeaky/rough right after washing or breakage during washing goes up.
whyItSuits: Weight low: no cationic, silicone or oil. It will not flatten fine strands or pull out the wave.
Moderate, buffered cleansing: enough to clear film from a lamination mask + oil on a weekly basis without being a clarifying shampoo.
Scalp-friendly: pH 5.5, 3% urea, panthenol, daily-use positioning. Suits a dry-feeling scalp with no current complaints.
limits: Conditioning low: zero slip in the wash. For bleached hair that snaps and tangles, the wash step itself gives no detangling help, so knots and breakage during washing are the risk.
SLES-led: on very porous bleached lengths it can feel drying if worked through the lengths. Use it on the scalp and let the lather run through.
Contains perfume. Irrelevant for her today (no scalp complaints), but worth knowing if itching appears.
The 'Feuchtigkeit' claim mainly concerns the scalp; it is not a moisture or repair shampoo for the lengths.
whatToWatch: Lengths feel squeaky, straw-like or rough right after rinsing -> too much cleansing for her lengths; consider a gentler / more conditioning fine-hair shampoo for this slot.
More broken hairs or knots during or right after washing -> wash technique / pre-wash conditioning, not necessarily the shampoo.
Wave drops or hair feels coated by day 2-3 -> more likely the mask + oil amount than this shampoo; this shampoo actually helps here.
customerFit.engineNote: Product truth vs user fit (Section 15): the v1.6 projection is fine-ideal but projects only the sensitive-scalp bucket (irritationen). If Viola's scalp bucket is 'trocken', the engine would not show this product in her cell (unless Nick rules the dry-scalp claim in). That is not a reason to tell her to stop using it.
callQuestions: Which shampoo do you use for the second wash each week, and how do your lengths feel right after rinsing this one compared to that one (soft vs squeaky/rough)?
Do you put the shampoo only on the scalp or work it through the lengths, and do you notice many knots or broken hairs during or right after washing?
How much Syoss glaze mask and Neqi oil do you use, and does your hair feel flat or coated by day 2-3, with the waves dropping?
customerFit.boundaries: Cosmetic guidance only. No claims about scalp disease, tolerability guarantees or hair-loss effects.

openIssues.issue: The sensitive-scalp claim appears only on rossmann.de (no 'Kopfhaut' wording on the pack front; pack back not seen). It was treated as the exact manufacturer DE page (Rossmann is the brand owner) -> E1 moderate. If a reviewer instead treats rossmann.de as retailer copy -> E1 low -> no sensitive target -> needs_research. Resolving needs a photo of the pack back.
openIssues.cautiousDefaultApplied: Moderate (manufacturer-page tier); this directly decides whether a target is emitted, so pack-back verification is recommended before apply.

openIssues.issue: Does 'schützt Kopfhaut & Haar vor Austrocknung' count as an E2 dry-scalp claim? Not emitted under P0. If Nick rules yes, S-DRY passes the formula gate and a secondary 'dry' (trocken) target would be added, giving fine/normal x trocken rows.

open-questions.md Q1 (moderate weight on fine hair) does not apply: W is low, so fine is ideal under both the cautious and the wider option. Q2-Q5 do not apply (W not high, C not used for an ideal, no oily claim, no reset positioning).
Live product_shampoo_specs rows were not read. Compare before any apply (review_live_value_differs).
